description: Imports Qualtrics surveys, their question definitions, and individual survey responses from the Qualtrics v3 API.

placeholders.data_center: user-supplied `data_center` endpoint config field (Qualtrics data center ID such as 'fra1', 'syd1', 'dub1'); lower-cased and stripped by a pydantic field validator

spec.apiVersionPinning: path segment `/API/v3` baked into every URL

configFields.name: credentials.credentials_title
configFields.description: Discriminator, fixed literal "Private App Credentials". Only one credential variant exists.

configFields.name: credentials.access_token
configFields.description: Found in Account Settings > Qualtrics IDs under 'API' section.

configFields.name: data_center
configFields.description: Qualtrics data center ID (e.g. 'fra1', 'syd1', 'dub1'). Found in Account Settings > Qualtrics IDs. Interpolated into the base URL host.

configFields.name: start_date
configFields.description: Start date for fetching survey responses (ISO format). Defaults to 180 days ago, truncated to midnight UTC. Seeds the incremental cursor.

configFields.name: advanced.window_size
configFields.description: Window size in days for incremental streams; default 30, must be > 0. Bounds each survey_responses export window.

configFields.name: interval
configFields.description: Standard CDK ResourceConfig poll interval; defaulted per stream by the connector.

paginator.cursorPath: result.nextPage (the `offset` query parameter is parsed out of that URL)

pathPlaceholders.survey_id: `id` of each survey yielded by the full `surveys` sweep, which is re-run in its entirety as the parent of this stream

authTierRationale: The only credential variant is `Auth(AccessToken)` with a single `access_token` field, sent verbatim in the `X-API-TOKEN` header (TokenSource is constructed with `oauth_spec=None`, so no token exchange or refresh occurs). The user pastes one self-serve API token from Account Settings > Qualtrics IDs plus a non-secret data center ID. No OAuth app registration and no refresh token, so T1_SIMPLE.

unionMisfits.description: survey_responses is not a paginated read at all: it is a three-phase asynchronous export job, per-survey, fanned out over the full `surveys` sweep, with a windowed date range and a compressed NDJSON download. No PullSpec member models create->poll->download, so `pull` is left null rather than forced into `kind: "http"`. The flow per survey is: (1) POST /surveys/{survey_id}/export-responses with JSON body {format: "ndjson", startDate: <cursor ISO8601>, endDate: <min(cursor+window_size days, now) ISO8601>, compress: true} -> result.progressId; (2) GET /surveys/{survey_id}/export-responses/{progressId} every 2 seconds until result.status == "complete" or result.fileId is set, raising on status == "failed"; (3) GET /surveys/{survey_id}/export-responses/{fileId}/file, streamed, unzipped, split on newlines, `{}` lines discarded, each remaining line parsed as one SurveyResponse and stamped with the parent surveyId. Cursor bookkeeping: the connector tracks max(values.recordedDate) across all surveys and emits max+1ms; if a window produced zero documents it advances only when the window end is more than 1 hour in the past, otherwise it deliberately does not advance to avoid missing late-arriving data.

proposedShape.parentFanout: one job per survey returned by the /surveys sweep

unionMisfits.description: survey_questions has no independent listing endpoint. Each sync re-runs the entire paginated /surveys sweep and issues one /survey-definitions/{survey_id}/questions request per survey. The schema's `pathPlaceholders` records the dependency but nothing expresses that the parent sweep is itself a paginated, separately-billed stream re-executed inside the child.

The connector never composes a base URL plus a path; each call site formats a complete absolute URL from the data_center. Two of the three stream families also sit under different first path segments (/surveys vs /survey-definitions), so the shared prefix is only /API/v3.

proposedShape.note: paths above are normalized by the miner to be relative to https://{data_center}.qualtrics.com/API/v3

abstained.streams[2].pull.incremental: survey_responses is retrieved by an asynchronous create->poll->download export job (POST /surveys/{survey_id}/export-responses, GET .../{progressId}, GET .../{fileId}/file returning zipped NDJSON), fanned out over every survey. No PullSpec union member represents a job flow, and forcing it into kind:"http" would misrepresent both the record source and the absence of a paginator. The full flow is recorded verbatim in unionMisfits[0].proposedShape.
abstained.streams[2].pull.backfill: There is no separate historical leg. The single incremental function starts from `start_date` and walks forward in `window_size`-day windows, so backfill and incremental are the same code path; recording a distinct backfill spec would be an invention.
abstained.streams[0].pull.snapshot.paginator.pageS: PAGE_SIZE = 500 is defined at api.py:25 with the comment 'Max allowed by Qualtrics API' but is never referenced anywhere in the connector; no limit/pageSize parameter is sent on any paged request. Recording 500 would assert a request parameter the code does not send.
abstained.streams[1].pull.snapshot.recordsPath: The code reads `result.elements` as a list (ApiResponse[PaginatedResponse]) at api.py:115-117, but models.py:100-102 defines an unused QuestionsResponse whose `elements` is a dict[str, dict]. The two disagree about the shape of this endpoint's payload; `result.elements` is the path actually used, but the container type is not settled by the source.
abstained.streams[1].pull.snapshot pagination beyo: _fetch_survey_questions parses the response as PaginatedResponse (which carries nextPage) but never inspects nextPage and never loops. Whether the endpoint can page is not decidable from this source; recorded as {"type":"none"} because that is what the connector does, not because the API is known to be unpaged.
abstained.transports[0].spec.defaultHeaders: No connector-wide default headers are configured on the HTTP session. validate_credentials (resources.py:54-57) hand-builds {X-API-TOKEN, Content-Type: application/json} for its single probe request only; the capture path relies on TokenSource for the auth header and sets no Content-Type.
abstained.execution.defaultSchedule: No connector-wide default exists; both intervals are set per-binding in initial_config (15m for the two full-refresh streams, 5m for survey_responses) and are recorded on the streams.
abstained.streams[*].supportedSyncModes for the fu: surveys and survey_questions are registered only via common.open_binding(fetch_snapshot=...) with a tombstone; no incremental path exists for them in the source.
